note: Held-out classifier set. Written on 2026-11-06 after the rules and fixtures were frozen, without reference to rules.ts, with deliberately varied phrasing. Do NOT tune rules or prompts against these items; they exist to measure how the classifier generalizes. All people and messages are synthetic. receivedAt is the same for every item so relative dates have one reference point (Fri 2026-11-06, 2:00 PM ET).
